title: Intent Contract
description: Security contract derived from the user's original goal, binding future actions to allowed capabilities.

user_goal.description: The user's original goal in natural language.

allowed_actions.description: List of tool actions permitted under this intent.

forbidden_actions.description: List of tool actions explicitly forbidden under this intent.

risk_budget.description: Maximum acceptable risk level for actions under this intent.

approval_required_for.description: Action categories that require human approval before execution.

intent_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalized intent fields.
